2607.17108.title: Evidence Interfaces Shape How Retrieval-Augmented Readers Use Support
2607.17108.paper_summary: In multi-hop RAG evaluation, a top-k answer score can hide two different failures: the retrieval window may drop part of the support chain, or it may contain support in a form the adapted reader does not use well. We call this reader-facing form of retrieved evidence an evidence interface. Using three support-annotated multi-hop QA benchmarks, we compare matched adapted readers trained with raw context, retrieval windows, and gold-support diagnostic renderings. These comparisons distinguish support-availability failures from remaining reader-interface effects. Top-k windows become interpretable only after checking whether the complete annotated support chain survives: when it does, short ranked windows can match or improve over raw context; when it does not, missing support explains much of the loss. Gold support-first improves matched readers; on 2Wiki and MuSiQue, a support-supervised ranker raises coverage and recovers raw-context quality at lower prompt cost, while retaining gold headroom. Support-removal checks further show that the gains rely on exposed evidence, not only answer priors. On support-annotated evaluations, top-k answer scores should therefore be reported together with complete-support coverage.
2607.17108.paper_summary_zh: 在多跳 RAG 評估中，top-k 答案得分可能隱藏兩種不同的失敗：檢索窗口可能會丟失部分支持鏈，或者它可能包含以適應的讀者不善於使用的形式呈現的支持。我們稱這種面向讀者的檢索證據形式為證據介面。使用三個支持標註的多跳 QA 基準，我們比較了使用原始上下文、檢索窗口和金標支持診斷渲染訓練的匹配適應讀者。這些比較區分了支持可用性失敗和剩餘的讀者介面效應。只有在檢查完整的標註支持鏈是否存活後，top-k 窗口才變得可解釋：當它存在時，短排名窗口可以匹配或改善原始上下文；當它不存在時，缺失的支持解釋了大部分的損失。金標支持優先改善了匹配讀者；在 2Wiki 和 MuSiQue 上，支持監督的排序器提高了覆蓋率，並在較低的提示成本下恢復了原始上下文的質量，同時保留了金標的空間。支持移除檢查進一步顯示，這些增益依賴於暴露的證據，而不僅僅是答案先驗。在支持標註的評估中，因此應該將 top-k 答案得分與完整支持覆蓋一起報告。
